title: a task cancelled after the future it awaits has settled keeps that outcome and is cancelled at its next await
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

stdout.text:
main observed 42
cancel requested
worker observed 42
worker cleanup
-1

provenance.expected_basis: main and the worker await the child, main first; the child's settlement queues main, then the worker. main cancels the queued worker before it runs. Cancellation is cooperative: the worker's await already has its outcome, so it continues with 42, and the Cancelled is delivered at its next await, which unwinds through its defer.
